name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: 5wCal coordinate-selection diagnostic/fix. V0.61 proved that the second touch event reaches the app, so V0.62 stops treating timing as the primary fault. Snapshot the first touch x/y as primitive values, validate the calendar cell index explicitly, select by cell index, buzz 200 ms on successful selection, and show NO XY plus a 500 ms buzz if usable touch coordinates are missing. Keep the 700 ms calendar window temporarily for isolation; Orbit remains unchanged.
